ALLIENT INC is a public company headquartered in Williamsville, New York, with the ticker ALNT and CIK 0000046129. The text harvested from its website describes an international financial services firm called Alantra with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia. According to that text, the firm provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors, and operates under what it describes as a listed partnership model in which teams work within corporate governance structures while retaining autonomy and holding personal stakes in the business.

The record lists no AI products and no MCP servers for the company, so there is no tracked AI offering to describe.

On litigation, the company's recorded law exposure is in New York, with a count of 368. No individual cases are listed.
